description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log messages within an application's UI. It implements the LogNode interface to receive and format log data, providing features such as color-coded log levels, thread-safe UI updates, and chainable logging nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: Custom Android TextView for logging output, implementing LogNode to receive log data, format it, and display it within the UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays log data received via LogNode interface, converting log priority to string, handling exceptions, updating the UI thread, and passing logs to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new log line in the LogView.
